title.zh: v1.16.9 消除移动端 0.19 的布局位移，并补上真实浏览器性能门禁
title.en: v1.16.9 Eliminated the 0.19 mobile layout shift and added a real-browser performance gate

highlights.zh: 定位并修复移动端 CLS 0.191：逐条 layout-shift 记录显示全部来自页脚——懒加载视图挂载前文档刚好一屏高、页脚可见，挂载后被推走 1763px。现在加载占位预留整屏高度，页脚在首屏即位于折叠线以下，位移不再计入
highlights.en: Diagnosed and fixed the 0.19 mobile CLS: every layout-shift record pointed at the footer, which was visible at one-screen height before the lazy view mounted and then pushed down 1763px. Loading placeholders now reserve a full viewport, so the footer starts below the fold and the swap no longer counts

highlights.zh: 星系视图画布高度改用 dvh，移动端浏览器地址栏不再遮挡画布底部
highlights.en: The galaxy canvas now sizes with dvh so mobile browser chrome no longer covers its bottom edge

highlights.zh: CI 与慢轨新增真实浏览器性能门禁（Playwright + 浏览器性能 API），硬性断言首屏不加载多余曲风数据，并打印 FCP/LCP/CLS 供回归对比——替代本机无法安装的 Lighthouse
highlights.en: CI and the slow track gained a real-browser performance gate (Playwright + browser performance APIs) that hard-asserts no unnecessary genre data on first paint and reports FCP/LCP/CLS — replacing the Lighthouse step that cannot be installed here
